description: The chart illustrates inference time, measured in minutes, for different models and methods on the MATH dataset. The horizontal axis represents the models and methods—Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, DPO, and O1-Pruner—and is labeled accordingly, with the categories arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Inference Time (minute),” represents the time in minutes and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5 for the left chart and 1 for the right chart. The left chart displays bars for Marco-o1-7B, with the Baseline bar reaching approximately 1.5 minutes, the Fast-Solving Prompt bar reaching 1 minute, the SFT bar reaching 0.8 minutes. The right chart displays bars for QwQ-32B-Preview, where the Baseline bar is approximately 6 minutes, the Fast-Solving Prompt bar approximately 5 minutes, the SFT bar approximately 4 minutes, the DPO bar approximately 3 minutes, and the O1-Pruner bar reaching approximately 4 minutes. All bars are displayed in a consistent orientation and are not visually emphasized through shading or outlines. The chart comprises two separate bar charts, presented side-by-side, each representing a different model.
